readme.en:
Control compatible legacy Belkin Wemo devices directly on your local network with Homey Pro, without a Wemo cloud account. Discover your devices, switch them on and off, adjust supported dimmers and use Insight power and energy readings in your Flows. This independent community app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Belkin.

This is a test release. For new or reset devices, a guided iPhone setup using the free Scriptable app is included; it currently supports WPA2/AES and 8–63 character ASCII Wi-Fi passwords. Scriptable is only needed for initial Wi-Fi setup, not daily control. Hardware and firmware compatibility varies; please use the linked community topic for setup instructions, tested models and feedback.
readme.fr:
Pilotez les anciens appareils Belkin Wemo compatibles directement sur votre réseau local avec Homey Pro, sans compte cloud Wemo. Découvrez vos appareils, allumez-les, réglez les variateurs compatibles et utilisez les mesures de puissance et d’énergie Insight dans vos Flows. Cette application communautaire indépendante n’est ni affiliée à Belkin ni approuvée par Belkin.

Il s’agit d’une version de test. Pour les appareils neufs ou réinitialisés, un parcours guidé sur iPhone avec l’application gratuite Scriptable est inclus ; il prend actuellement en charge WPA2/AES et les mots de passe Wi-Fi de 8 à 63 caractères ASCII. Scriptable sert uniquement à la configuration Wi-Fi initiale. La compatibilité dépend du modèle et du firmware ; consultez le sujet communautaire lié pour les instructions, les modèles testés et vos retours.

readme.en:
Avoid parking service fees and save money on parking with Sesam Pay for Homey Pro. Parking apps like Sesam Sesam and EasyPark charge a service fee per parking session on camera-based parking facilities. If you disable automatic charging in your parking app and pay directly on the operator website within 48 hours after leaving the facility, you avoid this service fee completely. The main challenge is remembering the 48-hour deadline before invoices or extra fees are issued.

Sesam Pay automatically monitors your registered vehicles by regularly checking for unpaid parking sessions. As soon as a new parking session is detected, you can receive alerts on your Homey Timeline, smartphone, Slack, or email. The app also reminds you when less than 12 hours remain before the payment deadline expires, and lets you copy direct payment links to complete payment with BankID in your browser. With flexible Flow cards, you can build automations based on detected parkings, remaining time, and completed payments.

Because standard Homey push notifications do not support clickable links, sending notifications through Slack or email in your flows is recommended for the smoothest experience, allowing you to open the payment link directly.

This is an unofficial app developed independently for Homey and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Hi Tech Mobility AS, Sesam Sesam, EasyPark, or Bergen Parkering. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
readme.no:
Unngå servicetillegg og spar penger på parkering med Sesam Pay for Homey Pro. Parkeringsapper som Sesam Sesam og EasyPark legger på et servicetillegg per parkering på skiltgjenkjente parkeringsanlegg. Hvis du deaktiverer automatisk trekk i appen og i stedet betaler direkte på nettsiden innen 48 timer etter utkjøring, slipper du dette tillegget helt. Utfordringen er å huske 48-timersfristen før faktura eller purregebyr påløper.

Sesam Pay overvåker automatisk dine registrerte kjøretøy ved å jevnlig sjekke etter ubetalte parkeringer. Så snart en ny parkering oppdages, kan du få varsler på Homey Tidslinje, mobil, Slack eller e-post. Appen gir deg også påminnelser når det er under 12 timer igjen av betalingsfristen, og lar deg kopiere direkte betalingslenke for enkel betaling med BankID i nettleseren. Med allsidige Flow-kort kan du bygge automatiseringer basert på nye parkeringer, gjenstående tid og fullførte betalinger.

Siden standard push-varsler i Homey ikke støtter klikkbare lenker, anbefales det å sende varsler via Slack eller e-post i flytene dine, slik at du kan åpne betalingslenken direkte.

Dette er en uoffisiell app utviklet uavhengig for Homey, og er ikke tilknyttet, sponset av eller godkjent av Hi Tech Mobility AS, Sesam Sesam, EasyPark eller Bergen Parkering. Alle varemerker tilhører sine respektive eiere.
